edges.reason: transferFrom calls ensure to validate the transfer before mutating balances
ensure delegates to condition when the sender is not whitelisted
transfer forwards the call to transferFrom with msg.sender as source
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whose allowance to consume
_from parameter flows into the transferFrom body
_to parameter flows into the transferFrom body
_value parameter flows into the transferFrom body
_from is passed into ensure for the whitelist check
owner is compared in ensure and bypasses all sale restrictions
tradeAddress is compared in ensure and bypasses all sale restrictions
canSale[_from] whitelist flag is read in ensure
_value is forwarded from ensure into condition
the locally computed _UNI pair address is compared against _from in ensure
_saleNum caps how many sales a non-whitelisted address may perform
_minSale lower bound is enforced in condition
_maxSale upper bound is enforced in condition
_onSaleNum[_from] is read against _saleNum in condition
msg.sender must equal owner to execute the delegatecall
target address a flows into delegate
calldata b flows into delegate
delegate performs an arbitrary external delegatecall via the unsafe operation
address a is the delegatecall target
bytes b becomes the delegatecall calldata
_mints restricts minting to owner or a hardcoded privileged address
batchSend restricts execution to owner
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without safe math
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction
batchSend computes total by multiplying _value and the array length
_value is a multiplicand of the unchecked total computation
_tos.length is a multiplicand of the unchecked total computation
batchSend adds _value to balanceOf[_to] inside the loop without safe math
_value is the amount added to recipient balances
the _tos array supplies each recipient for the balance credit
the local total is used for the sender balance accounting in batchSend
the local total variable is produced inside batchSend
init requires msg.sender to be the owner
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender to be the owner
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender
the constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
the owner state variable is initialized in the constructor
owner gates the privileged delegate function

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a parameter only meaningful as part of transferFrom and disappears once the function's argument list is absorbed
_to is a parameter used solely inside transferFrom for balance crediting
_value is the transferFrom amount operand with no standalone identity outside the call
address a is the delegatecall target parameter belonging to delegate
bytes b is the raw calldata forwarded directly into the a.delegatecall(b) unsafe operation
_tos is the recipient array parameter of batchSend
_value is the per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend
total is a temporary local computed and consumed entirely within batchSend
_UNI is a temporary local pair address computed and consumed entirely within ensure
